_comment: A map recipe (#331, decision 0010): the land before anything is placed on it. size: the square map's side in metres, centred on the origin. relief: metres from the lowest to the highest the noise reaches. flatness: 0 leaves the noise as it is; towards 1 the middle heights flatten into broad gentle land and only the extremes rise into hills. layers: noise summed for the height, each with frequency (1 / metres), amplitude (share of relief), type (smooth or ridged) and octaves. walkable: max_grade (rise per metre a player still walks easily) and min_share (the least share of the map that should be that gentle; the tests hold every seed to it).
